title: Desert Rock and Bloom
hook: Some desert moments last; some only pass.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: polished 3D desert nature storybook, rocks succulents and open sky, muted warm colors, strong silhouettes

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a quiet observer comparing geological stillness with short-lived movement, bloom and water
creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: hold the contrast between what stays and what briefly changes
creativeFingerprint.grooveMeter: open 4/4 with long stone holds and short living pickups
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written contrast images; geology lines can be sparse while living lines move more quickly
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: still/moving cue -> recall beat -> target -> safe contrast gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Verses stay sparse; chorus widens; retrieval strips back. dry shaker footsteps and sparse marimba echoes with open space
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: dry shaker footsteps and sparse marimba echoes with open space
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Set hard desert geology beside brief living change: rock, dune and wadi may hold still for long stretches while flowers, birds and animals appear, move, bloom or vanish on much shorter clocks.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child compares still/moving, hard/soft, old/new and dry/bloom; recurring language uses stone, edge, grain, open, pass, wait and after rain.
semanticArc: begin with stone and plant contrast
evening returns the scene to long quiet
forbiddenGenericLanguage: desert plants are fun to see
